simple.meaning: רָבִיב (râbîyb) is a Hebrew concept word meaning “a rain (as an accumulation of drops).” BibleIQ follows how Scripture develops this idea across its occurrences.
simple.biblicalBackground: The concept appears 6 times across Deuteronomy, Psalms, Jeremiah, Micah, beginning at Deuteronomy 32:2. Its contexts include land.
simple.inThisVerse: In this verse, the tapped English word is source-aligned to רָבִיב (H7241).
simple.whyItMatters: Concept words shape biblical themes. BibleIQ keeps the concept grounded in actual verse evidence instead of starting with a later theological definition.
